segments.sn48.54:1.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ [jaṅgamānaṃ (sī. pī.)] pāṇānaṃ padajātāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ – mahantattena;
segments.sn48.54:1.2: evameva kho, bhikkhave, yāni kānici padāni bodhāya saṃvattanti, paññindriyaṃ padaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ – bodhāya.
segments.sn48.54:1.3: Katamāni ca, bhikkhave, padāni bodhāya saṃvattanti?
segments.sn48.54:1.4: Saddhindriyaṃ, bhikkhave, padaṃ, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati;
segments.sn48.54:1.9: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ – mahantattena;
segments.sn48.54:1.10: evameva kho, bhikkhave, yāni kānici padāni bodhāya saṃvattanti, paññindriyaṃ padaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ – bodhāyā”ti.

lines: 524-525. Catutthe yāni kānici padāni bodhāya saṃvattantīti yāni kānici dhammapadāni, ye keci dhammakoṭṭhāsā, bujjhanatthāya saṃvattanti.
